description:
Current smart-money holdings: what funds and smart traders are holding right now, sorted by USD value. Use it when the user asks what smart money currently owns or has positions in.

[Access: pay 0.02 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

chains.description: Optional list of chains to include.

include_labels.description: Smart-money wallet labels; omitted uses Fund and Smart Trader.

name: get_smart_money_holdings
